CI 280.name: Introduction to Teaching English Language Learners
CI 280.description: Language, culture, instruction, assessment, and professionalism as they relate to teaching English Language Learners in U.S. schools.

CI 295A.name: Introductory Field Experience for Teacher Preparation
CI 295A.description: Observational and tutoring work in pre-K through 4th grade settings with professional teacher supervision. Bulletin recommends prior EDPSY 11/HDFS 229/CI 280/EDPSY 14/EDTHP 115 and 2nd-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 405.name: Reimagining Classroom Management
CI 405.description: Equitable classroom management approaches to co-creating classroom communities. Bulletin also requires 4th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 460.name: The Creative Child
CI 460.description: Relationships among the various arts and material inquiries and learning for children in the preschool and elementary years.

CI 495A.name: Clinical Application of Instruction - PK-4
CI 495A.description: Practicum situation for demonstration of selected instructional strategies and management skills acquired in professional training. Bulletin requires official clearances, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 495D.name: Practicum in Student Teaching--Childhood and Early Adolescent Education
CI 495D.description: Full-time classroom instruction in elementary and early childhood/middle-level education, supervised by University personnel and practicing teachers. Bulletin also requires 7th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly. Prereq modeled as an OR of CI 495A (PK-4, used by Elementary and Early Childhood Education) and CI 495B (Middle Level, used by Middle Level Education) -- each major's own suggested plan only ever schedules the one applicable to its own PK-4/middle-level track.

CI 495F.name: Professional Development Practicum
CI 495F.description: Instruction concurrent with student teaching practicum, focused on solving instructional problems identified at the practicum site. Bulletin also requires 7th-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 295.name: Introductory Field Experience for Teacher Preparation
CI 295.description: Introductory field experience for secondary teacher preparation. Bulletin requires 2nd-semester standing and official clearances, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 495C.name: Clinical Application of Instruction -- Secondary Education
CI 495C.description: Practicum for secondary education instructional strategies. Bulletin lists LLED 412W/MTHED 412W/SCIED 412/SSED 412W as corequisites -- only SCIED 412 (the science-content-area course) applies to this Secondary Education Biology Teaching plan; the others are content-area-specific variants for English/Math/Social Studies teaching options and were treated as a bulletin template artifact for this option.

CI 495E.name: Practicum in Student Teaching--Secondary Education
CI 495E.description: Full-time secondary student teaching practicum. Bulletin also requires 7th-semester standing and lists LLED 412W/MTHED 412W/SSED 412W as additional prereqs -- same content-area-template artifact as CI 495C; only SCIED 412 applies to this Biology Teaching option.

CI 295B.name: Introductory Field Experience in Middle Level Education
CI 295B.description: Introductory field experience in middle-level education settings. Bulletin also requires 2nd-semester standing, which the planner schema does not model directly.

CI 495B.name: Clinical Application of Instruction - Middle Level Education
CI 495B.description: Practicum for middle-level education instructional strategies. Bulletin requires admission to the Middle Level Education major, which the planner schema does not model directly.
